answer_1.quote: Given the description text of a MWP, an automatic solver needs to output an expression for solving the unknown variable asked in the problem that consists of mathematical operands (numerical values) and operation symbols (+, -, ×, ÷), as shown in Fig. . It requires that the solver not only understand the natural-language problem but also be able to model the relationships between the numerical values to perform arithmetic reasoning.
answer_1.outputs: mathematical expressions consisting of numerical values and operation symbols (+, -, ×, ÷)

answer_2.quote: We use answer accuracy as the evaluation metric: if the value predicted by the solver equals the true answer, it is thought of as correct.
